source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cybersecurity awareness (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Cybersecurity awareness (online hifazat ke bare mein jaankari) ka matlab hai online khatron se khud ko bachane ke tareeqe samajhna aur un par chalna (practice karna). Agle do hisse is ke do pehlu batate hain: khatre pehchanna aur personal maloomat bachana.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Cyber crime (online jurm) ki shikayat NR3C-FIA (FIA ka National Response Centre for Cyber Crime) par ki ja sakti hai: https://www.nr3c.gov.pk. (Shikayat ka tareeqa aur idara waqt ke saath badal sakta hai; shikayat se pehle abhi ki official website check karein.)

blocks.prompt: Cybersecurity awareness ke do pehlu bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Khatre pehchanna (phishing scams, malware) aur personal maloomat bachana (privacy settings, public jagah par personal details na dalna).

items: Cybersecurity awareness: online khatron se bachao ke tareeqe samajhna aur apnana; cyber crime ki report NR3C-FIA par.
